## A leaf cell at night

A leaf cell is full of chloroplasts, which make food in sunlight. It is night now, and the same cell is still alive and still at work.

**Predict:** Where does this cell get the energy for its work tonight?

options.text: Its chloroplasts go on making food and energy in the dark.
It stops all its work and waits for the sunrise.
Its mitochondria release energy from stored food.
